name: 30 Pack - 30x1g Pre-roll - Cadillac Rainbow
description:
Thirty joints, one box. The 30 Pack Cadillac Rainbow gives you thirty full-gram pre-rolls — 30 grams total — rolled with quality flower and ready to smoke. No grinding, no rolling, no running out. Just grab one and go.

Cadillac Rainbow brings a smooth, colorful flavor spread: sweet mixed fruit and candy-berry notes up front, rounded out by a creamy, subtly earthy finish. It's a rich, taste-forward smoke that rides easy from start to finish — flavorful, mellow, and built for laid-back sessions.

Why you'll love it:

30 × 1G pre-rolls — 30 grams total, serious value in one box
Ready to smoke — no grinding, no rolling, no setup
Signature Cadillac Rainbow flavor — sweet mixed fruit and candy berry with a creamy finish
Smooth, easygoing effects — mellow and relaxed, great any time of day

Big value, dependable quality, and everyday convenience in every box. The 30 Pack Cadillac Rainbow is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
